passages.note: Ramos appears in the Ayes list for final Assembly passage of ACA 5.

passages.provision_quote: That Section 31 of Article I thereof is repealed.
passages.note: The operative clause only repeals the Prop 209 ban; it does not itself mandate or enforce anything.

rows.reasoning: Ramos voted Aye on ACA 5 (2019-2020), whose operative text reads 'That Section 31 of Article I thereof is repealed,' removing the Proposition 209 ban on considering race, sex, or ethnicity in public employment, education, and contracting. This shows opposition to 'eliminate affirmative action and all race-based government programs,' but a bare repeal permits rather than requires race-conscious programs, so it does not itself 'mandate racial equity requirements in all institutions' or 'strengthen civil rights enforcement and address systemic discrimination.'
